intro: Colorado has something no other region on this site can offer: the WWV transmitter site itself, just outside Fort Collins. The atomic-clock time signal that shows up in the nationwide list is generated here, and you can stand at the fence and listen to it arriving on four shortwave bands at once. Beyond that novelty, this is high-altitude radio country — from a fourteener or a pass on the Continental Divide, a handheld reaches across half the state.
introz: 科罗拉多有一样本站其他地区都提供不了的东西：WWV 发射台本身，就在柯林斯堡城外。全美通用列表里那个原子钟时间信号就是从这里发出的，你可以站在围栏外，同时在四个短波频段上听到它抵达。除了这份特别，这里是高海拔无线电的天下——在一座十四千英尺高峰或大陆分水岭的山口上，手台能覆盖半个州。

stations.n: WWV — you are standing at the transmitter
stations.z: WWV · 你就站在发射台旁
stations.d: The NIST time and frequency station broadcasts from a site north of Fort Collins on 2.5, 5, 10, 15 and 20 MHz simultaneously. Nowhere else can you receive all five with a handheld at full strength. The 20 MHz signal in particular is usually marginal elsewhere in the country and comes in perfectly here. There is a small visitor pull-off on the road past the antenna field.
stations.dz: 美国国家标准与技术研究院的时间与频率台位于柯林斯堡以北，同时在 2.5、5、10、15、20 MHz 上发播。在别处，用手台无法把五个频率都收到满格。尤其 20 MHz 在全国其他地方通常都很勉强，而在这里信号完美。天线场旁的公路上有一处小型观景停车带。

stations.d: The highest of the five and the one that proves you are close.
stations.dz: 五个频率里最高的一个，能收到就证明你离得很近。

stations.d: The lowest, normally a night-only frequency. Audible here in daylight.
stations.dz: 最低的一个，通常只有夜间可收。在这里白天也听得到。

stations.n: WWVB 60 kHz — below the VX-6's range
stations.z: WWVB 60 kHz · 低于 VX-6 下限
stations.d: The low-frequency signal that sets every radio-controlled clock in North America transmits from the same site at 60 kHz. The VX-6R stops at 500 kHz, so this one you can only visit, not hear.
stations.dz: 为北美所有电波钟校时的低频信号也从同一站点以 60 kHz 发播。VX-6R 下限为 500 kHz，所以这个只能去看，听不到。

stations.d: Ranger dispatch, Trail Ridge Road status and a steady stream of high-altitude rescues. Trail Ridge crosses 3,700 metres and closes with snow for much of the year — the road status traffic is genuinely practical. Scan 162–174 MHz in NFM.
stations.dz: 护林员调度、Trail Ridge 公路状况，以及持续不断的高海拔救援。Trail Ridge 公路最高超过 3700 米，一年中很长时间因雪封闭——路况通话确实实用。用 NFM 扫 162–174 MHz。

stations.d: Colorado's fire seasons are severe and the state has a large air-tanker operation. This band is busy from June onward.
stations.dz: 科罗拉多的火季相当严峻，全州有规模很大的灭火机队。六月起这个波段就很忙。

stations.z: 林务局 Arapaho / Roosevelt / San Juan
stations.d: Forest Service trail crews and fire lookouts. Scan 168–173 MHz too.
stations.dz: 林务局的步道队和火情瞭望台。也扫一下 168–173 MHz。

stations.n: 2 m Simplex Calling — from a fourteener
stations.z: 2 米直通呼叫 · 在十四千英尺高峰
stations.d: Colorado has fifty-eight peaks above 4,267 metres. From the summit of any of them a 5 W handheld covers a genuinely absurd area — Pikes Peak and Mount Blue Sky are both drivable if you would rather not walk.
stations.dz: 科罗拉多有五十八座超过 4267 米的山峰。在其中任何一座顶上，5 瓦手台的覆盖范围荒谬得离谱——派克峰和 Mount Blue Sky 都可以开车上去，如果你不想走。

stations.d: Machines on the Front Range peaks cover Denver, Boulder and Fort Collins from a single site. Confirm on RepeaterBook for Denver, Boulder and Larimer counties.
stations.dz: 前山峰顶的中继台从一个站点就能覆盖丹佛、博尔德和柯林斯堡。请在 RepeaterBook 查 Denver、Boulder 和 Larimer 县确认。

stations.z: 1.25 米呼叫频率 · 本地活跃
stations.d: Colorado has a real 1.25 m community, which is unusual and worth a listen given your radio covers the band.
stations.dz: 科罗拉多有真正活跃的 1.25 米群体，这不常见——你的电台覆盖这个波段，值得听一听。

stations.d: Six runways on the plains east of the city, with high-altitude performance considerations in every summer departure. Sweep 118–136 MHz.
stations.dz: 位于城东平原上的六条跑道，夏季每一次离场都要考虑高原性能问题。扫 118–136 MHz。

stations.z: 丹佛区调 · 山区扇区
stations.d: From a pass on the Divide you will hear enroute traffic from an implausible distance.
stations.dz: 在分水岭的山口上，能收到远得不可思议的航路通话。

stations.d: Aspen, Telluride, Leadville and Eagle are among the most demanding airports in the country. Leadville is the highest public-use airport in North America at 3,026 metres.
stations.dz: 阿斯彭、特柳赖德、莱德维尔和 Eagle 是全美难度最高的机场之一。莱德维尔海拔 3026 米，是北美最高的公用机场。

stations.d: Afternoon thunderstorms above treeline are the main hazard for hikers here, and they are remarkably punctual. Get the forecast before you start walking.
stations.dz: 林线以上的午后雷暴是这里徒步者的主要危险，而且时间惊人地规律。出发前先听预报。

stations.d: Coverage is patchy in the valleys. Try from a pass.
stations.dz: 山谷里覆盖不稳定，请在山口尝试。

stations.d: The Moffat Tunnel route through the Front Range and the line up the Colorado River canyon are spectacular railroad territory. Helper locomotives and tunnel ventilation coordination make for interesting listening.
stations.dz: 穿越前山的 Moffat 隧道线路和沿科罗拉多河峡谷上行的线路是极为壮观的铁路路段。补机作业和隧道通风协调的通话很有意思。

stations.d: A working coal-fired steam railroad using modern radio. The combination is a genuine curiosity.
stations.dz: 一条仍在运营的燃煤蒸汽铁路，却使用现代无线电。这个组合本身就很有意思。

stations.d: Volunteer-run since 1978 and genuinely eclectic.
stations.dz: 自 1978 年起由志愿者运营，节目非常多元。

stations.z: KCFR 科罗拉多公共广播

stations.d: Colorado runs more mountain rescue missions than any other state, and mutual-aid channels stay analog.
stations.dz: 科罗拉多的山地救援任务数量全美第一，互助频道仍是模拟制式。

stations.d: Resorts, backcountry guides and avalanche control teams use MURS VHF and FRS. Very active at Vail, Aspen and Loveland Pass.
stations.dz: 度假区、野雪向导和雪崩控制队使用 MURS VHF 与 FRS。在 Vail、阿斯彭和 Loveland 山口非常活跃。

stations.z: 丹佛警消 · 数字集群

stations.d: High altitude and thin dry air. Excellent from any summit.
stations.dz: 高海拔、干燥稀薄的空气。在任何山顶效果都极好。
